question: Based on posts posted by Community, calculate the percentage of posts that use the R language.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "posts_with_parent_tags" AS WITH child AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(id AS BIGINT) AS post_id,
    CAST(posttypeid AS INT) AS post_type_id,
    CAST(owneruserid AS BIGINT) AS owner_user_id,
    ownerdisplayname AS owner_display_name,
    CAST(parentid AS BIGINT) AS parent_id,
    tags
  FROM table_7
),
parent AS (
  SELECT CAST(id AS BIGINT) AS id, tags AS parent_tags
  FROM table_7
)
SELECT
  c.post_id,
  c.post_type_id,
  c.owner_user_id,
  c.owner_display_name,
  c.parent_id,
  CASE WHEN c.post_type_id = 1 THEN c.tags ELSE NULL END AS tags,
  CASE WHEN c.post_type_id = 2 THEN p.parent_tags ELSE NULL END AS parent_tags
FROM child c
LEFT JOIN parent p
  ON c.post_type_id = 2 AND c.parent_id = p.id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH cp AS (
  SELECT
    post_id,
    post_type_id,
    owner_user_id,
    owner_display_name,
    parent_id,
    tags,
    parent_tags,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(tags, ''), parent_tags) AS eff_tags
  FROM posts_with_parent_tags
  WHERE (owner_display_name = 'Community' OR owner_user_id = -1)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_posts_by_community,
  SUM(CASE WHEN eff_tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r_posts_by_community,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN eff_tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
  END AS percent_r_posts_by_community
FROM cp
